# xshield_azure_enforcement_receipt (Resource)

Reports to Xshield that an Azure enforcement snapshot has been applied, and which Azure resource was created for each key in it. The `azure` enforcement module sends it for you.

Place it in the same configuration as the snapshot's resources and reference their IDs, so it is only sent once they all exist. Xshield rejects a receipt whose version it did not publish, or whose resources omit or add to the snapshot's, so a partial or altered apply is never recorded as converged. An interface association may be left out once its network interface is gone.

A new receipt is sent only when the applied version, a resource ID, `exclusive_rules` or `resend_trigger` changes. Azure gives a network security group or association recreated under the same name its old ID, so an apply that restores one changes no ID: `resend_trigger` is how such an apply still sends the receipt, so Xshield observes the subscription and region at once rather than at its next drift interval. If Xshield's latest receipt for the subscription and region is no longer this one, the next plan proposes sending it again, and a plan that creates the receipt while Xshield already holds one warns. An imported receipt is not sent again when only `resend_trigger`, which an import cannot know, is new, so an apply right after an import that restores a group or association under the same ID sends no receipt, and Xshield observes the subscription and region at its next drift interval.

Destroying it removes it from state and leaves the receipt history in Xshield.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The azure enforcement module sends this for you. Written by hand, it must list
# the ID of every resource the snapshot asks for, and reference them, so it is
# sent only once they all exist.
resource "xshield_azure_enforcement_receipt" "this" {
  cloud_account_id = data.xshield_azure_enforcement_snapshot.this.cloud_account_id
  region           = data.xshield_azure_enforcement_snapshot.this.region
  workspace        = "xshield-enforcement-eastus2"
  snapshot_version = data.xshield_azure_enforcement_snapshot.this.version

  network_security_groups = { for key, group in azurerm_network_security_group.this : key => group.id }
  subnet_associations     = { for key, association in azurerm_subnet_network_security_group_association.this : key => association.id }
  interface_associations  = { for key, association in azurerm_network_interface_security_group_association.this : key => association.id }
  # Changes whenever the apply recreates a group or association, which Azure gives its old ID.
  resend_trigger = join(",", [for key in sort(keys(terraform_data.applied)) : terraform_data.applied[key].id])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_account_id` (String) Azure subscription the snapshot was applied to.
- `network_security_groups` (Map of String) Network security group ID created for each key in the snapshot's `network_security_groups`.
- `region` (String) Azure region the snapshot was applied to.
- `snapshot_version` (String) Version of the snapshot that was applied, from `xshield_azure_enforcement_snapshot`; Xshield accepts a receipt only for a version it published.
- `workspace` (String) Name of the enforcement workspace that applied it, as shown in Xshield.

### Optional

- `exclusive_rules` (Boolean) Whether each network security group in `network_security_groups` holds only the rules the snapshot declares, so the next apply removes a rule added to it outside Terraform. The `azure` enforcement module sets it from `enable_exclusive_rules`. Changing it sends the receipt again; it does not replace it.
- `interface_associations` (Map of String) The import ID of the association created for each key in the snapshot's `interface_associations`, `<network interface ID>|<network security group ID>`.
- `resend_trigger` (String) Any value that changes whenever the apply creates, replaces or updates a network security group or association the receipt names; a change sends the receipt again and is not itself sent. The `azure` enforcement module sets it from a `terraform_data` record replaced on each such change.
- `subnet_associations` (Map of String) The import ID of the association created for each key in the snapshot's `subnet_associations`, the subnet's ID.

### Read-Only

- `applied_at` (String) When Xshield recorded the receipt.
- `id` (String) Receipt identifier assigned by Xshield.
- `run_id` (String) Run that sent the receipt, taken from `TFC_RUN_ID` when running in HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an Azure subscription's receipt by subscription ID and region. This adopts the receipt Xshield currently holds,
# which recovers a lost state file without recording a new apply.
terraform import xshield_azure_enforcement_receipt.this "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/eastus2"
```
